propositions: Alias resolution in commit_impact.referencing_commits performs O(distinct_aliases x store) full tracker scans, causing precheck hangs (70+ minutes) on production-scale stores with 5300+ tickets.
The resolver currently executes a fresh os.listdir(tracker) plus per-ticket JSON read for each distinct alias encountered, rather than reusing a single index.
A single-pass alias index built once per referencing_commits call and threaded through resolve_ticket_id reduces full tracker scans from N (per distinct alias) to 1.
The optional alias_index parameter to resolve_ticket_id preserves backward compatibility; single-id callers remain unaffected and default to per-call scanning behavior.
Correctness is maintained: all id forms (full, short, alias, Jira, prefix) and ambiguous-alias cases resolve identically whether indexed or per-call scanned.
